verdict.rationale: Quo ships one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors and an official public MCP server so users can 'manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.' The documented natural-language operations include sending and broadcasting texts, pulling and filtering message history, retrieving call and voicemail transcripts, searching, adding and updating contacts, and reviewing missed calls. Missing for 10: natural-language control of admin and configuration features (call routing, phone menus, ring orders, number setup) is not documented; NL operation works only through an external agent, with no in-app command interface; no independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL commands work reliably.
